elements.requirement: An employer in relation to a relevant occupational pension scheme must permit an employee who is a trustee of the scheme to take time off during working hours to perform any duties as such a trustee or to undergo training relevant to the performance of those duties.
elements.quote: shall permit an employee of his who is a trustee of the scheme to take time off during the employee’s working hours for the purpose of— (a) performing any of his duties as such a trustee, or (b) undergoing training relevant to the performance of those duties

elements.requirement: The amount of time off permitted to an employee, along with the purposes, occasions, and conditions for taking it, must be reasonable in all the circumstances, having regard in particular to how much time off is required for performing trustee duties and undergoing relevant training, as well as for the particular duty or training.
elements.quote: reasonable in all the circumstances having regard, in particular, to— (a) how much time off is required for the performance of the duties of a trustee of the scheme and the undergoing of relevant training, and how much time off is required for performing the particular duty or for undergoing the particular training

elements.requirement: The reasonableness of the amount, purposes, occasions, and conditions of an employee's time off must have regard in particular to the circumstances of the employer’s business and the effect of the employee’s absence on the running of that business.
elements.quote: having regard, in particular, to— (b) the circumstances of the employer’s business and the effect of the employee’s absence on the running of that business

elements.requirement: The statutory rules on time off for pension scheme trustees apply to an employee who is a director of a company that is a trustee of a relevant occupational pension scheme in the same manner as they apply to an employee who is a trustee of such a scheme.
elements.quote: applies to an employee who is a director of a company which is a trustee of a relevant occupational pension scheme as it applies to an employee who is a trustee of such a scheme

elements.requirement: A relevant occupational pension scheme is defined as an occupational pension scheme (as defined in section 1 of the Pension Schemes Act 1993) established under a trust.
elements.quote: “ relevant occupational pension scheme ” means an occupational pension scheme (as defined in section 1 of the Pension Schemes Act 1993) established under a trust

elements.requirement: References to the employer in relation to a relevant occupational pension scheme are to an employer of persons in the description or category of employment to which the scheme relates.
elements.quote: references to the employer, in relation to such a scheme, are to an employer of persons in the description or category of employment to which the scheme relates

elements.requirement: References to training include training undertaken on the employer’s premises or elsewhere.
elements.quote: references to training are to training on the employer’s premises or elsewhere

elements.requirement: An employee's working hours are taken to be any time when, in accordance with the contract of employment, the employee is required to be at work.
elements.quote: the working hours of an employee shall be taken to be any time when, in accordance with his contract of employment, the employee is required to be at work
